entities.summary: Ross Shor Lynch is an American singer and actor. He was the lead vocalist of the pop rock band R5 and is one half of the band the Driver Era. As an actor, he rose to recognition for his leading roles as Austin Moon on Disney Channel's comedy television series Austin & Ally (2011–2016) and Brady in the network's musical films Teen Beach Movie (2013) and its sequel Teen Beach 2 (2015).
